Best performers

K. Lewis-Potter (BRE): 2 goals
J. Anthony (BRE): 2 assists
F. Carvalho (BRE): 1 goal

Brentford beat Everton 4–0, with Keane Lewis-Potter scoring in the 23rd and 25th minutes. James Tarkowski was sent off for Everton in the 40th minute, and Vitaly Janelt and Fábio Carvalho added later goals.

Brentford climbed from 10th to 6th on 17 points; Everton dropped from 7th to 9th on 16.
